description: Top wallets on one Hyperliquid market by volume or realized PnL, up to 200 rows.

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, or ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default 24 hours ago

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, or ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Default now

name: get_market_top_wallets

first_seen_ms.description: First fill in the window, Unix milliseconds

last_seen_ms.description: Last fill in the window, Unix milliseconds

pct_maker.description: Share of fills as maker, 0 to 1

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: Top wallets in a market
